title: Only Snow
description: A Minecraft mod which adds only snow biome generation settings to the game.
body:
#


Only Snow

A premium, custom world generation Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.2 that restricts the Overworld entirely to snowy and icy biome variants, while maintaining complete vanilla compatibility for other dimensions. --- ## ❄️ Features * **Snow-Only Overworld:** All Overworld biomes dynamically map to their snowy counterparts at sampling time: * Plains, forests, jungles, taigas, deserts → `Snowy Plains` / `Snowy Taiga` * Oceans & Rivers → `Frozen Ocean` / `Deep Frozen Ocean` / `Frozen River` * Beaches → `Snowy Beach` * Mountains & Slopes → `Frozen Peaks` / `Jagged Peaks` / `Snowy Slopes` / `Grove` * **Two Custom World Presets:** 1. **Only Snow Biomes:** Standard biome sizes and vanilla structure/animal spawn frequencies. 2. **Only Large Snow Biomes (Less Structures):** Harsh mode featuring horizontally stretched biomes (larger, wider mountain ranges and spread-out ice spikes) with a **95% reduction** in surface structures, trees, vegetation, and passive friendly animals. * **Vanilla Conservation:** Underwater generation (seagrass, monuments), ruined portals, underground structures, strongholds, mineshafts, trial chambers, and other dimensions (Nether/End) are kept **100% untouched**. * **Modern Config UI:** A beautiful, fully custom configuration screen cycling button controls with zero external dependencies, accessible via Mod Menu. * **Compatibility First:** Fully compatible with temperature/survival mods (like *Cold Sweat*) and performance mods. Includes built-in engine redirects to prevent crashes with Level-of-Detail caching mods (like *Voxy*) and input managers (like *Controlify*). --- ## 🖥️ Server-Side Configuration If you are hosting a dedicated server, you can configure the mod directly using server files: ### 1. Selecting the World Preset Before launching the server to generate the world, set the `level-type` property in **`server.properties`** to one of the following: * **Only Snow Biomes (Normal Biomes):** `level-type=only_snow:only_snow` * **Only Large Snow Biomes (Less Structures):** `level-type=only_snow:only_large_snow` ### 2. Custom Spawning & Structure Rates You can configure the generation and spawning rates on the server by editing the **`config/only_snow.json`** file: ```json { "structureReduction": 95, "animalReduction": 95, "treeReduction": 95 } ``` ## 🤝 Known Compatible Mods Only Snow is designed with compatibility in mind. It has been tested and verified to work flawlessly with the following popular mods: * **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu):** Full in-game configuration integration via our custom settings screen. * **[Cold Sweat](https://modrinth.com/mod/cold-sweat):** Perfect integration with temperature mechanics. Because Only Snow maps to vanilla snowy biomes, freezing temperatures operate natively. * **[Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy):** Level-of-detail rendering works without any saving or file-locking crashes due to our custom save-redirect mixins. * **[Controlify](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlify):** Fully compatible with controller/input setups. * **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium):** Renders the vast snowy and icy landscapes at high framerates. * **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) & [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me):** Dynamic multithreaded worldgen and chunk tick optimizations operate without conflict. --- ## 🛠️ Credits & Authorship Developed and maintained by **[@TomerGamerTV](https://github.com/TomerGamerTV)**. --- ## ⚖️ License Licensed under the **Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International License** (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0).
